name: Tempester: NRPN reception (live sound parameter edits from MIDI, DIN and USB)
explanation: Before: NRPN had no effect. The DIN parser ([routine], [address]-[address]) stored number and value in [address]-[address] and nobody read them; USB never parsed CC 6/38/96-101. Now: the DIN path forwards every CC to [routine] like USB, and [routine] calls a hook (0x9d07a100) that keeps the source in t0. Non-NRPN CCs go to the original [routine] unchanged. CC 6/38/96-101 are consumed by a per-source NRPN state machine stored in the 16 bytes freed from the old DIN parser (DIN [address], USB [address]; .bss, zero at boot = nothing selected). CC 99/98 select the number (127/127 = null), CC 100/101 (RPN) deselect, CC 6 stores the data MSB, CC 96/97 are absorbed, CC 38 applies: number 0-126 = sound parameter of the same index (table [address], profile/dsi-tempest/sound_params.json), 156/157 = Osc 3/4 sample (0-463); every other number is refused (name characters included). Value = MSB*128 + LSB, clamped to the table max. Target sound: Remote Pad IN channel ([address], or All) = selected pad; else MIDI: Synth IN channel = MIDI: Synth Sound; else ignored. Beat = [address], as the knobs. The change goes through the knob path [routine](beat, pad, p, target - current): same clamps (Osc 3/4 frequency 40-88, LFO rate/sync), couplings, Revert base and voice sends as a knob; it distributes no UI event (whole call tree checked), so calling it from the main-loop MIDI parsers is safe. [address] is set to 1 around that call (anti-echo flag of the optional emission patch). Parameters that a knob does not send live (glides, key follows, wave resets, glide mode, envelope delays, reverses, 124) take effect at the next note, as with a knob. The LCD is not forced to redraw. Code added at 0x9d07a100-0x9d07a2ff (128 words). Note (2026-11-08): bytes [address], [address], [address] and [address] of the stock parser's state are not used by this patch and are reused by n°22 (led_emission).

edits.why: b [address] ; DIN CC path ([routine]): was "beq s0,v1,[address]" (CC 97 absorbed, then the CC 6/38/96-101 NRPN/RPN tree). Now every CC goes to the existing "other CC" path: move a1,s1 / move a2,s0 / jal [routine](1,ch,cc,val), like USB. The delay slot (move a3,v0 = value) is kept. The old DIN NRPN code [address]-[address] becomes unreachable, freeing its RAM [address]-[address].
or t0,a0,zero ; [routine] (CC to UI event): was "li a0,0xb0". Keeps the source (1 = DIN, 2 = USB) in t0 for the hook; the hook loads a0 = 0xb0 itself before the original call.
jal 0x9d07a100 ; [routine]: was "jal [address]" (publish event 10). The delay slot "sw zero,0x10(sp)" (5th argument = 0) is kept.
addiu t1,a2,-0x60 ; HOOK entry. Live: t0 = source, a1 = channel 0-15, a2 = CC, a3 = value, ra = [address], sp = [routine] frame with 0x10(sp) = 0. CC 96-101?
j [address] ; any other CC: original path, unchanged (a1-a3, ra, sp and 0x10(sp) untouched)
li a0,0xb0 ; restores the replaced "li a0,0xb0"
addiu sp,sp,-0x30 ; NRPN/RPN CC: consumed here, never published (the old DIN parser absorbed them too; USB ignored them)
andi t0,t0,0x1 ; state block: DIN (source 1) [address], USB (source 2) [address]; +0 u16 number (bit 15 = selected), +2 u16 data MSB << 7
lhu t2,0x0(s0) ; t2 = current NRPN number word
beq a2,t1,0x9d07a1d8 ; CC 38: data LSB, applies
bne t1,zero,0x9d07a1c4 ; CC 100/101 (RPN select): deselect the NRPN so RPN data entry (e.g. pitch bend range) never hits a sound parameter
sh zero,0x2(s0) ; new number: data MSB back to 0
sll t3,a3,0x7 ; store MSB << 7, apply nothing (avoids a transient value)
andi t1,t2,0x8000 ; no NRPN selected (boot, RPN, null): ignore
lbu t1,0x49eb(gp) ; target sound. Remote Pad IN channel [address] (0 = All)
lbu t1,0x4a50(gp) ; MIDI: Synth IN Channel [address] (0 = Off)
lbu s1,0x4a52(gp) ; s1 = pad = MIDI: Synth Sound [address]
lbu s1,-0x7b16(gp) ; s1 = pad = selected pad [address] (UI object [address] + 0x52)
sltiu t1,s2,0x7f ; whitelist: 0-126 sound parameters, 156/157 Osc 3/4 sample; everything else refused (name 127-146, pad overflow beyond)
sll t1,s2,0x2 ; max = word at [address] + p * 20 (parameter table [address], field +4)
or s3,t1,zero ; value > max: value = max
lw a0,-0x7a2c(gp) ; a0 = beat being edited, word [address] (UI object + 0x13c), same as the knobs
addiu t1,s2,-0x9c ; 156/157: current = 128 * byte[15 or 21] + (byte[14 or 20] & 0x7f), as [routine]
addu s0,t1,t2 ; s0 = 0 (Osc 3) or 6 (Osc 4); state pointer no longer needed
beq a3,zero,0x9d07a2e4 ; unchanged: nothing to do
sb t1,-0x7f78(gp) ; [address] = 1: change comes from MIDI (read by the optional emission patch: no echo)
jal [address] ; knob path: [routine](beat, pad, p, delta) = clamps, couplings, SRAM write, voice sends
